products.name: Daab Chingri
products.desc: Tender prawns cooked in a rich mustard and coconut cream blend, served inside a fresh green coconut shell.

products.name: Bhapa Ilish
products.desc: The queen of fish, Hilsa, steamed to perfection with a sharp, pungent paste of mustard, poppy seeds, and green chilies.

products.name: Kosha Mangsho
products.desc: Velvet-textured mutton pieces slow-cooked over hours in a thick, spicy, dark gravy of caramelized onions and traditional spices.

products.name: Bhetki Paturi
products.desc: Fresh fillet of Bhetki marinated in mustard, coconut, and chili paste, wrapped neatly in banana leaf envelopes and steamed.

products.name: Chingri Malai Curry
products.desc: Giant golda prawns simmered gently in spiced coconut milk, bay leaves, cardamom, and pure golden ghee.

products.name: Kolkata Mutton Biryani
products.desc: Dum cooked fragrant long-grain Basmati with tender goat meat, sweet spiced Kolkata potato, and farm-fresh boiled egg.

products.name: Grand Bengali Non-Veg Thali
products.desc: Royal heritage platter: Steamed Gobindobhog rice, Basanti Pulao, Luchi, Shukto, Bhetki Paturi, Kosha Mangsho, Chutney & Rosogolla.

products.name: Royal Seafood Platter
products.desc: Marine banquet feast: Daab Chingri, Bhetki Paturi, Fish Kabiraji, and Chingri Malai Curry served with fragrant saffron rice.

products.name: Dhokar Dalna
products.desc: Crispy spiced chana dal diamond cakes simmered in a fragrant ginger, cumin, and whole garam masala golden gravy.

products.name: Chanar Dalna
products.desc: Handmade melt-in-mouth fresh paneer chenna dumplings fried golden and stewed with diced potatoes in rich Bengali gravy.

products.name: Baked Rosogolla
products.desc: Kolkata sponge rasgullas enveloped in thick reduced kheer and baked to a caramelized, decadent golden crust.

products.name: Nolen Gurer Ice Cream
products.desc: Artisanal slow-churned ice cream infused with pure winter date palm jaggery (Nolen Gur) and roasted cashew praline.
